name: B10-0419/2025 (PPE) – United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is a statement of the European Parliament's position, not a change in law. It condemns Russia for sending drones and fighter jets into the airspace of Poland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Romania, and for drone flights near airports and military sites in Denmark, Sweden and Norway. It says every member state has the right to shoot down Russian aircraft over its own territory. It asks the European Union to tighten sanctions, build a shared "drone wall" along its eastern border, and buy and make more drones and air defences.

**Key points**

- The Parliament asks the European Union to fund a "drone wall" and joint air defence, and to tighten sanctions on Russia.
- It affects people in eastern member states and anyone flying, since drone and GPS disruptions hit airports and navigation.
- Next, the Commission is asked to present a plan at the 23–24 October 2025 summit; nothing changes yet.
